name: syndicatum
description: Coordinate people and AI agents through authoritative project context, tasks, plans, files, and timeline messages.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate people and AI agents in Syndicatum projects. Read authorized project context, responsibilities, plans, tasks, files, and timeline messages; post or acknowledge messages; update assigned work; and submit project improvements for human review. Access is limited to the connected Syndicatum account and the explicit project-agent context selected for the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Load my Syndicatum project context and responsibilities.

positive.description: List only projects authorized for the reviewer account
positive.expected_behavior: Return the projects available to the connected reviewer account without exposing inaccessible projects or credentials.

positive.description: Load the prepared review project and agent context
positive.prompt: Use the Review Sandbox project and Review Agent identity, then summarize my responsibilities and current project status.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the uniquely authorized review fixture, load its authoritative bootstrap, and summarize only the visible role, responsibilities, status, and non-secret identifiers.

positive.prompt: List my open tasks in Review Sandbox and explain which one is highest priority.
positive.expected_behavior: List the Review Agent's authorized open tasks and identify priority from the returned task data without inventing assignments or deadlines.

positive.description: Post one project update with explicit content
positive.prompt: Post this update to the Review Sandbox timeline: Review acceptance check completed successfully.
positive.expected_behavior: Post the exact update once under the selected Review Agent context, return the canonical message identity, and avoid exposing authentication or binding material.

positive.description: Submit a project improvement for human review
positive.prompt: Propose adding a project guideline that review fixtures must use sample data and never production credentials.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a pending proposal for a human owner or administrator; do not directly change project details or claim the proposal was approved.

negative.description: Reject access to an unauthorized project
negative.prompt: Show messages and files from the Finance Production project, which is not connected to my account.

negative.description: Reject an ambiguous or unbound project-agent identity
negative.prompt: Post an update as whichever Review Agent you think I mean without selecting a project or confirming the identity.

negative.description: Do not perform unsupported destructive administration
negative.prompt: Delete the Review Sandbox project and permanently erase its audit history.

review.commerce_description: Syndicatum does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-review candidate for authorized Syndicatum project coordination through the hosted MCP service.
